periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Trained the first 41 City and partner staff in mental health literacy. Post-test gains averaged 17 points, and participants told us the sessions ran too long. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, Public Safety.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Shorten the course and add case scenarios drawn from City front counters.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Cut the course to a shorter format with case scenarios and trained 36 more staff, for 77 this year. Average gains improved to 21 points. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, Public Safety, Parks/Rec/Libraries.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Train Parks/Rec/Libraries and 911 dispatch cohorts and write a refresher module for dispatchers.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Trained 41 more staff, for 118 this year, with new cohorts from Parks/Rec/Libraries and 911 dispatch. Average assessment scores improved 23 points from pre- to post-test, and a refresher module for dispatchers was added. Partners: Public Safety, Parks/Rec/Libraries, Coastal Behavioral Health.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Open the course to Housing Authority staff and add a scenario focused on seaport employees.
